mapper.insert: insert ignore into x_storage_delete_task (storage_path, retry_count, next_retry_time, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{storagePath}, 0, DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE), 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: select id, storage_path, retry_count, next_retry_time, status, lock_until, last_error, create_time, update_time from x_storage_delete_task where next_retry_time <= #{now} and (status = 0 or lock_until <= #{now}) order by next_retry_time asc, id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update x_storage_delete_task set retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, status = 0, lock_until = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = NOW() where id = #{id}
